children: may extend gains into a range of $100.28-$101.26 per barrel, as suggested by a projection analysis.
The uptrend remains intact, though it is slowing. An expanding wedge seems to be forming, with the upper trendline pointing to a target around $101.26.
Immediate support is at $98.69, a break below which may trigger a fall into $97.71-$97.10 range. Only a break below $97.10 could suggest a reversal of the uptrend.

On the daily chart, the contract broke resistance at $98. The break opened the way toward $102.67. A projection analysis on wave C from $78.19 suggests a higher target of $110.24, while a wedge indicates a much more aggressive target of $117.
There is an early sign of the resumed uptrend from $58.72.
